description: Comparison of VOPP1 C-terminal YxxPhi to LAMP-2/LAMP-1 signals, and ortholog-wide motif census
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, re
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
def cterm(acc,n=20):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",headers=H,timeout=60).text
    s="".join(t.split("\n")[1:]); return s,s[-n:]
print("=== C-terminal tyrosine sorting signals: VOPP1 vs canonical lysosomal membrane proteins ===")
for acc,name in [("Q96AW1","VOPP1 human"),("P13473","LAMP2 human"),("P11279","LAMP1 human"),
                 ("Q14108","SCARB2/LIMP-2"),("P08962","CD63"),("Q13596","SNX1 (control, not TM cargo)")]:
    try:
        s,c=cterm(acc)
        yx=[(m.start()+len(s)-20+1, m.group()) for m in re.finditer(r'(?=(Y..[LIVMFA]))', c)]
        yx=[(len(s)-20+m.start()+1, c[m.start():m.start()+4]) for m in re.finditer(r'Y(?=..[LIVMFA])', c)]
        print(f"  {name:24s} len {len(s):4d}  C-term20 {c}   YxxPhi in C-term20: {yx}")
    except Exception as e: print(name,"ERR",e)

print("\nVOPP1 YEQV(165-168) vs LAMP-2 lysosomal signal GYEQF: Y+1 E=E, Y+2 Q=Q, Phi V vs F")

# conservation of the YxxPhi pattern across the ortholog panel (re-derived)
url=("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=(gene:VOPP1)+AND+(taxonomy_id:7742)"
     "&fields=accession,organism_name,length,sequence&format=json&size=500")
res=requests.get(url,headers=H,timeout=120).json()['results']
df=pd.DataFrame([dict(acc=e['primaryAccession'],org=e['organism']['scientificName'],
                      length=e['sequence']['length'],seq=e['sequence']['value']) for e in res])
df=df.sort_values('length',ascending=False).drop_duplicates('org')
df=df[df.length.between(150,215)]
print("\northolog set for C-terminal motif scan: n =",len(df))
def classify(s):
    tail=s[-25:]
    ppxy = re.findall(r'PP.Y', tail)
    yxxphi = re.findall(r'Y..[LIVMF]', tail)
    return len(ppxy), len(yxxphi), tail
df[['n_ppxy_C25','n_yxxphi_C25','tail25']]=df.seq.apply(lambda s: pd.Series(classify(s)))
print("  orthologs with >=1 PPxY in C-terminal 25 aa: %d/%d (%.0f%%)"%((df.n_ppxy_C25>0).sum(),len(df),100*(df.n_ppxy_C25>0).mean()))
print("  orthologs with >=1 YxxPhi in C-terminal 25 aa: %d/%d (%.0f%%)"%((df.n_yxxphi_C25>0).sum(),len(df),100*(df.n_yxxphi_C25>0).mean()))
print("  orthologs with BOTH overlapping (PP.Y..[LIVMF]): %d/%d (%.0f%%)"%(
    df.seq.str.contains(r'PP.Y..[LIVMF]').sum(),len(df),100*df.seq.str.contains(r'PP.Y..[LIVMF]').mean()))
print("  orthologs with 2+ PPxY anywhere: %d/%d (%.0f%%)"%(
    df.seq.apply(lambda s:len(re.findall('(?=PP.Y)',s))>=2).sum(),len(df),
    100*df.seq.apply(lambda s:len(re.findall('(?=PP.Y)',s))>=2).mean()))
print("  orthologs with any [DE]xxxL[LIM] dileucine: %d/%d"%(df.seq.str.contains(r'[DE]...L[LIM]').sum(),len(df)))
print("  orthologs with any NPF: %d/%d"%(df.seq.str.contains('NPF').sum(),len(df)))
print("  orthologs with any NP.Y: %d/%d"%(df.seq.str.contains(r'NP.Y').sum(),len(df)))
# cytoplasmic lysine count proxy: K after the conserved RRRM
def nK_tail(s):
    i=s.find('RRRM')
    return s[i:].count('K') if i>0 else np.nan
df['K_in_cytotail']=df.seq.apply(nK_tail)
print("\n  cytoplasmic-tail Lys count across orthologs:", df.K_in_cytotail.value_counts().sort_index().to_dict(),
      " median =", df.K_in_cytotail.median())

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.2))
cats=["PPxY in C-term 25","YxxPhi in C-term 25","overlapping PPxY+YxxPhi","2+ PPxY anywhere",
      "dileucine [DE]xxxL[LIM]","NPF","NPxY"]
vals=[100*(df.n_ppxy_C25>0).mean(),100*(df.n_yxxphi_C25>0).mean(),
      100*df.seq.str.contains(r'PP.Y..[LIVMF]').mean(),
      100*df.seq.apply(lambda s:len(re.findall('(?=PP.Y)',s))>=2).mean(),
      100*df.seq.str.contains(r'[DE]...L[LIM]').mean(),100*df.seq.str.contains('NPF').mean(),
      100*df.seq.str.contains(r'NP.Y').mean()]
cols=["#2b6cb0","#2b6cb0","#2b6cb0","#6b46c1","#a0aec0","#a0aec0","#a0aec0"]
ax[0].barh(cats[::-1],vals[::-1],color=cols[::-1]); ax[0].set_xlim(0,105)
ax[0].set_xlabel("%% of vertebrate VOPP1 orthologs (n=%d)"%len(df))
ax[0].set_title("Sorting and WW-ligand motifs across VOPP1 orthologs")
for i,v in enumerate(vals[::-1]): ax[0].text(v+1.5,i,f"{v:.0f}%",va="center",fontsize=8)
ax[1].hist(df.K_in_cytotail.dropna(),bins=np.arange(-0.5,8.5,1),color="#b7791f",edgecolor="k")
ax[1].set_xlabel("lysines in cytoplasmic tail (from conserved RRRM to C-terminus)")
ax[1].set_ylabel("ortholog count"); ax[1].set_title("Ubiquitin-acceptor lysines are scarce in the VOPP1 tail")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
